title: 第3章 小试牛刀第4章 孤男寡女
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
趁他病要他命的道理，赵大柱当然懂。
虽然他不会弄死陈强，可最起码要打的他再起不能。
于是赵大柱立即就大步上前，冲着陈强拳打脚踢。
砰砰砰的声音不断响起，赵大柱就好像痛殴落水狗一般暴打陈强。
这拳拳到肉的感觉，令赵大柱热血澎湃。
赵大柱仿佛觉得自己回到了年轻的时候，回到了那个谁都不怕不服就干的年纪！
他甚至觉得自己身体里的血好像都沸腾了，而且还在熊熊燃烧！
如果不是李玉娇就在不远处看着，赵大柱真想放声呐喊，道一声痛快！
而李玉娇此刻已经震惊的胸腔里那颗心都快从嗓子眼里跳出来了。
赵大柱完全没有了平时那种垂垂老矣的感觉，好像突然间变了一个人。
这……这到底是怎么回事啊！
李玉娇想不通，想不明白。
但她看向赵大柱的目光已经完全变了，变得目光灼灼，眼神里蕴含着某种说不清道不明的味道。
“别打了……别打了……赵老驴你再打就要出人命了……”
陈强抱头蜷缩身体，哭喊着求饶。
赵大柱皱眉道：“你叫我什么？”
赵老驴是杏花村的村民给赵大柱起的外号。
关系好的人这么叫他倒也罢了，这个陈强凭什么！
“我再问你一遍，你刚刚叫我什么？”
赵大柱恶狠狠的吼道，而且又是邦邦两拳落在陈强的脸上，打的陈强鼻血长流眼冒金星。

陈强哪里还敢跟赵大柱犟，他连忙说道：“赵爷，我错了，求你别打了，我真的顶不住了……”
赵大柱这才终于停手。
李玉娇犹豫了一下，便迈步走了过来。
看着两手沾满鲜血的赵大柱，李玉娇竟然有点害怕他。
而且她一脸欲言又止的表情，似乎想说什么又不敢说。
赵大柱呼了口气，甩甩手上的血说道：“王建国应该快来了，我已经把这里发生的事情告诉他了。”
“什么？赵老头你……”
李玉娇吃惊的看着赵大柱，想不通他为什么要这样。
赵大柱是这么想的，反正陈强这么一闹，他和李玉娇今晚是肯定不能成就美事了。
既然如此，那还不如利用这件事，从王建国那里弄点好处。
王建国手里可是有他两亩地的，那两亩地是他的心头肉，不要回来的话他睡觉都睡不踏实。
但也正是因为陈强在这里，所以有些话不方便说，赵大柱干脆就什么都没说。
也就是这时，王建国终于来了。
刚到这里，王建国就跟头蛮牛似的冲到陈强跟前，抬起四十四码的大脚狠狠的在他身上踹。
“疤子你个狗日的，居然敢打我老婆的主意，你他妈失心疯了？”
王建国一边骂一边打，打的陈强叫苦不迭。
陈强此刻肠子都要悔青了。
content_en:
Of course Zhao Dazhu understood the principle of killing him while he was sick.
Although he won't kill Chen Qiang, he will at least beat him until he can't get up again.
So Zhao Dazhu immediately strode forward and punched and kicked Chen Qiang.
The sound of bang bang bang kept sounding, and Zhao Dazhu beat Chen Qiang like a dog in water.
The feeling of the punch hitting the flesh made Zhao Dazhu's blood rush.
Zhao Dazhu seemed to feel that he had returned to his youth, to the age where he was not afraid to do anything if he disobeyed anyone!
He even felt as if the blood in his body was boiling and still burning!
If Li Yujiao hadn't been watching from a short distance away, Zhao Dazhu would have really wanted to shout loudly and express his happiness!
And Li Yujiao was so shocked that her heart almost jumped out of her throat.
Zhao Dazhu completely lost his usual feeling of being old, as if he suddenly changed into a different person.
This... what the hell is going on!
Li Yujiao couldn't figure it out.
But the way she looked at Zhao Dazhu had completely changed, becoming intense, and there was something inexplicable in her eyes.
"Stop fighting... stop fighting... Mr. Zhao, if you hit him again, someone will die..."
Chen Qiang hugged his head and huddled up, crying and begging for mercy.
Zhao Dazhu frowned and said, "What did you call me?"
Zhao Laolv is the nickname given to Zhao Dazhu by the villagers of Xinghua Village.
It’s okay for people with good connections to call him that. Why is this Chen Qiang!
"I ask you again, what did you just call me?"
Zhao Dazhu roared viciously, and Bang Bang landed two more fists on Chen Qiang's face, causing Chen Qiang's nose to bleed and his eyes to bleed.
How dare Chen Qiang dare to fight with Zhao Dazhu? He quickly said: "Master Zhao, I was wrong. Please stop fighting. I really can't stand it anymore..."
Zhao Dazhu finally stopped.
Li Yujiao hesitated for a moment, then walked over.
Seeing Zhao Dazhu with his hands covered in blood, Li Yujiao was actually a little afraid of him.
And she had a hesitant expression on her face, as if she wanted to say something but didn't dare.
Zhao Dazhu exhaled, shook off the blood on his hands and said, "Wang Jianguo should be here soon. I have already told him what happened here."
"What? Old man Zhao, you..."
Li Yujiao looked at Zhao Dazhu in surprise, wondering why he was doing this.
That's what Zhao Dazhu thought. Anyway, if Chen Qiang makes such a fuss, he and Li Yujiao will definitely not be able to accomplish anything good tonight.
In this case, it is better to take advantage of this matter and get some benefits from Wang Jianguo.
Wang Jianguo had two acres of land in his hands, and those two acres were his heart and soul. If he didn't come back, he wouldn't be able to sleep well.
But it was precisely because Chen Qiang was here that it was inconvenient to say something, so Zhao Dazhu simply said nothing.
It was at this time that Wang Jianguo finally arrived.
As soon as he arrived here, Wang Jianguo rushed up to Chen Qiang like a bull, raised his forty-four-yard big foot and kicked him hard.
"Scar, you are such a bitch, you actually dare to take advantage of my wife. Have you lost your mind and gone crazy?"
Wang Jianguo scolded and beat him at the same time, which made Chen Qiang complain incessantly.
Chen Qiang's intestines were about to turn green at this moment.
